items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: So, he came out and we had a long jab. He was a heck of a nice guy and played nice, very good cornet.

ctx.x: Is a head arrangement that? Yeah, head arrangement. I suppose that's what it means. Yeah. The 85 standards. Yeah. And then it says here that...

Freddie just died recently. He was a radio announcer and TV down in Evansville, Indiana. I called him one time. My sister said he was... what the station was on, and I called him. Where are you? Where are you? Stay where you are. Stay where you are. I'll be there in a half hour. So, he came out and we had a long jab. He was a heck of a nice guy and played nice, very good cornet. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. He would have fit in nicely, but he didn't want to join the band, period. Mm-hmm. He didn't want to leave Indiana.…
Well, that's in the book here. In this book, anyway, it's pretty accurate. Um... Well...
